search.description: Search for jobs on LinkedIn for a specific role and company. If job role and company are not provided as command-line arguments, job roles will be taken from the interested_job_role file.

arguments.name: job_role
arguments.description: The job role/title to search for (e.g., 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist')

arguments.name: company
arguments.description: The company name to search jobs for
